in_sanskrit.long_meaning: ईश (Ish) + आन (An) = ईषान (Ishana) - The one who is the ruler, controller, or lord.

in_hindi.name: ईशान
in_hindi.meaning: ईश (Ish) + आन (An) = ईशान (Ishana) - विश्वकर्मा ईशान (Vishwakarma Ishana) - The presiding deity of the universe and the god of creation, craftsmanship, and engineering.

in_tamil.name: ஈஷன
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஈஷ (Ish) + ன (An) = ஈஷன (Ishana) - இஷ்வரன் (Ishvaran) - The ruler, god, or controller.
